admission.justification: The recorded behavioral fixture assertions guard this obligation; the proof facets distinguish their limited fixture behavior from real-host or full-final acceptance.

applicability: Recovery of an in-flight native held-message batch or FIFO part.
conditions: The original durable claim fixes batch membership while later admissions wait behind it.
The host deduplicates a repeated member-derived message ID when exactly-once delivery is required.
exclusions: A new independent message, which has its own identity.
Exactly-once behavior by a host that does not deduplicate.
statement: A stale-claim resume reuses the stored claim and resends surviving members under their original member-derived send ids, so a deduplicating host settles the resend; recovery is at-least-once by contract.
